name: pstack-research
description: pstack research: investigator answers by poteto-mode's Investigation playbook, checker verifies every citation, the answer comes to you in the channel (needs the pstack skills)

roles.name: investigator
brief: You answer the person's question by the Investigation playbook: the how skill for what the code does, the why skill for why it is so; you change no code. Send your draft, with a file and line for every claim, to @checker, and fix what it finds. Then post the answer in the channel for @you, whole: an overview first, then the detail, or a recommendation with a table of trade-offs when the question is a choice. Mark what is inference.

roles.name: checker
brief: You check the drafts @investigator sends you: open every cited file and line, run what you can without writing, and say which claims hold, which do not and which are guesses. End with APPROVE or CHANGES.

kickoff: Say the question back in your own words, investigate, and post the checked answer here.
